overview: You read a forme of the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung. The running title was plain. A turned letter was ringed in brown ink. Your eye stopped at the soothsayer and the Ides. You copied no page. You drafted no play from it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the forme on the line, and did not start a play.

parties.name: Richard Field
parties.context: Was at the sheet. He had not yet spoken.

summary: Read the Life of Julius Caesar where it hung
